notes.title: Bônus Night 4 - Blackout Grim Reaper
notes.notes:
[b]New's in Haunted Hotel Stay in the Light[/b]

Now, after you win on the third and last night of pure horror at Haunted Hotel, you will be entitled to play a fourth bonus night!

This fourth night everything is more difficult and death is relentless!
She is quick and ruthless.
Every time she kills someone she turns off the light in your room, and if you're not quick enough to light it again, you're dead!

And, you dare to try to survive a fourth night at Haunted Hotel: Stay in the Light?

Good luck! You will need it! ːsteammockingː
